name: Brain and Cognitive Sciences (BCS) PhD
department: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences / McGovern & Picower Institutes
toefl_det: IELTS: 7.0+ / TOEFL iBT: 100+; DET: Not Accepted
fee_waiver_info: MIT Graduate Application Fee Waiver available via OGE Office: https://oge.mit.edu/graduate-admissions/applications/fee-waivers/
intl_student_stats: Cohort size ~15-20, approx 30% international students. Full 5-year fellowship and stipend guaranteed.
faculty_match: Robert Desimone, Nancy Kanwisher, James DiCarlo, Josh Tenenbaum
notes: Rotations in 3 labs during year 1. World-leading integration of computational neuroscience, cognitive AI, and systems neurobiology.

name: Neurosciences Interdepartmental Program (IDP) PhD
department: School of Medicine & Wu Tsai Neurosciences Institute
toefl_det: TOEFL iBT: 100+ required (minimum subscores: R:20, L:20, S:20, W:20); DET: Not Accepted
fee_waiver_info: Stanford Biosciences Fee Waiver and School of Medicine ADVANCE program: https://biosciences.stanford.edu/how-to-apply/application-fee-waivers/
intl_student_stats: Accepts ~12-16 students/yr, ~25% international. Full tuition + health insurance + stipend ($53k+/yr) for all 5 years.
faculty_match: Surya Ganguli, Dan Yamins, Shaul Druckmann, Karl Deisseroth, Liqun Luo
notes: Three 10-week lab rotations in Year 1. Strongest computational neuroscience community bridging engineering, AI, and experimental physiology.

name: Program in Neuroscience (PiN) PhD
department: Harvard Medical School / Kenneth C. Griffin Graduate School of Arts and Sciences
toefl_det: TOEFL iBT: 100+ (subscores: 26+ speaking strongly recommended); DET: Not Accepted
fee_waiver_info: Harvard GSAS Application Fee Waiver application available inside application portal prior to deadline: https://gsas.harvard.edu/admissions/apply/application-fee
intl_student_stats: Cohort ~15-20 students, accepts international applicants with equal funding guarantee (tuition + $50k+ stipend).
faculty_match: Haim Sompolinsky, Jan Drugowitsch, Cengiz Pehlevan, Rachel Wilson, Florian Engert
notes: Home of the Center for Brain Science (CBS) and Kempner Institute for Natural & Artificial Intelligence. Exceptional theoretical neuroscience group.

name: PhD in Physiology, Development and Neuroscience (PDN)
department: Department of Physiology, Development and Neuroscience (School of Biological Sciences)
toefl_det: IELTS Academic: 7.5+ (minimum 7.0 in each subscore) or TOEFL iBT: 107+ (minimum 25 in each subscore); DET: Not Accepted
requires_master: No (First Class UK Bachelor's or international equivalent accepted)
fee_waiver_info: Cambridge Postgraduate Admissions Fee Waiver available for eligible candidates: https://www.postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/application-process/how-do-i-apply/application-fee
intl_student_stats: Cohort size ~30-35 across PDN, ~40% international. Gates Cambridge, Cambridge Trust, and MRC full scholarships available.
faculty_match: Ole Paulsen, Timothy O'Leary, Wolfram Schultz, Bill Harris
notes: Home of Brain Prize and Nobel laureates; Timothy O'Leary: homeostatic plasticity and computational biophysics; Wolfram Schultz: dopamine reward prediction error.

name: DPhil in Neuroscience (4-year Wellcome Trust / 3-year Track)
department: Department of Physiology, Anatomy and Genetics (DPAG) & Experimental Psychology
toefl_det: IELTS Academic: 7.5+ (minimum 7.0 in each component) or TOEFL iBT: 110+ (L:22, R:24, S:25, W:24); DET: Not Accepted
requires_master: No (First Class UK Bachelor's or international equivalent accepted)
fee_waiver_info: Oxford Graduate Application Fee Waiver available for eligible candidates from low-income backgrounds: https://www.ox.ac.uk/admissions/graduate/applying-to-oxford/application-guide/application-fee
intl_student_stats: Cohort size ~15-20 students, ~40% international. Clarendon Fund and Wellcome Trust provide 100% full fees + living stipend (£19,000+/yr tax-free).
faculty_match: Gero Miesenböck, Tim Behrens, Kia Nobre, Matthew Rushworth, Andrew King
notes: Gero Miesenböck: founding inventor of optogenetics; Tim Behrens: cognitive maps in prefrontal cortex and hippocampal navigation.

name: Doctoral Program in Information Technology and Electrical Engineering (D-ITET)
department: Department of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering & Institute of Neuroinformatics (INI)
toefl_det: TOEFL iBT: 100+ or IELTS: 7.0+ (English C1 level); DET: Not Accepted
requires_master: Yes (Master's degree or 4-year Bologna equivalent required)
intl_student_stats: Leading European technical university. ~65% of doctoral candidates are international. Full Swiss doctoral employment (CHF 50,000 - 65,000/yr).
faculty_match: Giacomo Indiveri, Richard Hahnloser, Benjamin Grewe, Stanisa Raspopovic
notes: Giacomo Indiveri: neuromorphic subthreshold analog VLSI circuits and cognitive chips; Stanisa Raspopovic: bionic leg sensory neuro-prostheses.
